Variable
Function
Repeat
If... then
Variable: a name used to save something and find it later. It is like putting a label on a box.
Function: a prepared action. You call it when you want the computer to do that job, like pressing a button on a machine.
Repeat: tells the computer to do the same task several times, like playing a song again and again.
If... then: the computer checks something and chooses what to do. Like: if you have Wi-Fi, use Wi-Fi; if not, use data.
